visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final portable frames after the bounded outline simplifier repair. Separate curved residential, hotel and office blocks, rooftop pods, strip glazing and projecting balcony bands remain legible. Courtyard gaps remain open. The public-domain aerials confirm the coordinated exterior; fine bay counts, equipment and low court details are generalized.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Actually inspected all seven final shared-material frames, including the north-up mapped placement overlay. Mineral concrete and painted-metal shared bindings preserve the cream horizontal rhythm; dark glazing is a portable material. All principal blocks retain their mapped alignment. Unload assertion passes. Flat placement fixture tests the transform; separate terrain views preserve the unchanged independent ground.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected all nineteen final frames: twelve lighting/distance/mode views, front/back, silhouette and four forced detail transitions. All nineteen report the current asset and actual runtime/LOD hashes. The corrected skyline preserves the curved plan within its declared simplification tolerance; dark glazing and pale bands remain consistent across transitions. Synthetic context buildings are style fixtures, not Washington parcels.

geographicReview.notes: The inspected public-domain Tim1965 schematic plan identifies three residences, the hotel with adjoining northern office, and the southern office. It supplies identity, not geodetic dimensions. The independent mapped features, frame coordinates, anchor, heading, dry reference, terrain and lower closure depths are unchanged. Native mapped high-volume solid/void controls pass at all four actual imported detail levels (1631 each, buffered 3 m from polygon edges). Rounded mapped part 35184818078673 is a rooftop volume. Ground remains the preserved coarse Terrarium field: 4225 samples over 512 m, courtyard datum 10.4144 m, mapped relief -5.993462..0.468684 m and lower closure -6.8 m. Entrance, pool and terrace levels are not surveyed; footprint suppression stays off.

fidelityReview.scope: Coordinated Watergate hotel, offices and three residential blocks; exterior with generalized rooftop and low court structures.
fidelityReview.notes: Fresh comparison of all 33 final renders against the inspected Alfred Twu CC0 whole-complex aerial, Indutiomarus public-domain closer aerial and Tim1965 public-domain labeled plan. Distinct curved blocks, courtyard gaps, pale balcony/spandrel bands, dark strip glazing and rounded roof forms are recognizable. Fine balustrade/bay spacing, appliances and low court structures remain original medium-fi estimates; pools, landscaping, interiors and exact terrace joins are omitted. No current imagery approval relies on the excluded historical images. References are never embedded as textures.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four current levels pass strict geometry/material budgets and were actually inspected: 1000/3656/14546/49972 triangles, 1/2/3/3 draw calls. Iterative simplification now bounds replacement chords against every original vertex on the removed arc, preventing cumulative outline drift. Actual Float32 imported meshes pass all 6524 mapped solid/void probes. The sample proof is not a global mesh-distance measurement.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact scoped source regeneration, normal import verification, four current-LOD checks, strict medium-fi audit, source/scene/terrain/placement schemas, six runtime pack members and repeated 30-tick state hashes pass. Raw and actual imported meshes pass geometry validation and 1631 mapped solid/void controls at each detail level. Ground, scene, map coordinates and cameras retain their pre-repair identities. No independent Khronos certificate is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior of the coordinated Watergate complex; mapped outlines and photographic proportions are generalized, not surveyed.

The three residential blocks, hotel wing, adjoining northern office and southern office are differentiated. The rounded T-shaped mapped part is a rooftop form, not another tower. Former Howard Johnson hotel is excluded.

Individual balconies, fine balustrades, service pods and roof equipment are interpretations from the selected aerial and street photographs. Not every bay, renovation or rooftop appliance is reproduced.
Low podium, entry and court structures are approximate; landscaping, pools, interiors, exact stair/ramp connections and adjacent streets are outside scope.
Coarse preserved host terrain controls ground contact; variable exposed foundation depth is not a surveyed basement elevation. References are inspected locally, not embedded or redistributed.
